subject: effects
reads: A weapon firing, a rat dying and a gem landing must each be legible in a frame holding a hundred enemies. Effects are the whole feedback loop: a hit nobody sees is a game with no combat.
camera: Same top-down 60 degree view as the world. An effect is 0.2 to 1 m across and lives under half a second, so it is a few dozen pixels on a phone for a few frames.
questions: How does an effect stay separable from the actors it is drawn over?
How bright must a hit be to read against a bright ground?
How long can an effect last before a hundred of them become fog?
